knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Stored heat, oil and energy can remain after switch-off. Isolation at the supply point is the control that removes the risk.
Stillness is confirmed by observation and listening after isolation. Pressing start to test the machine is the wrong method.
Switchboards are not opened by cleaners. If the isolator is not reachable under the site procedure, the job is stopped and referred.
The machine is turned off, allowed to stop, then isolated before cleaning near moving or powered parts.
Only the person who applied the isolation removes it, and only after checking that the machine is clear.

practicalCriteria: Turns the appliance off by its control, then isolates at the supply point per the site procedure
Confirms stillness by observation and listening without pressing start
Does not open a switchboard, remove a panel or defeat an interlock
Records isolation applied and removed, with names and times
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate: an assessor observes the practical criteria and records the result. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not grant any licence or authority.
evidenceRequired: Isolation record with method, times and names
Lock or tag applied where the site provides them
Referral record where isolation was not possible
stopWorkCriteria: Isolator not reachable under the site procedure, and the worker proceeds
Any attempt to reset a tripped device to test the machine
